posts.zh:
dsh-eyes 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d4330cac1d4ba98d072c.html
posts.en:
dsh-eyes is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d4330cac1d4ba98d072c.html
